lesson.grammar_point: verb to be (am / is / are) + subject pronouns

listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome. The language of this event is English, in all the rooms. Please put your badge on. The big room is on the first floor. The coffee is on the first floor too, next to the big room. The first talk starts at nine o'clock. If you need help, please talk to a volunteer. Thank you, and have a very good day.

Hello, and thank you for joining our research group. Our next meeting is on Monday, at four o'clock. The meeting is online, on Google Meet. Please say your name and your country first. After that, we talk about technology in schools. The meeting is one hour. See you on Monday.

extra_audio.text: Joice arrives at the event. She says her name to a man. She says she is from Brazil. She says she works in education. She asks the man to repeat.
